Netanagri Full Video:
Mayawati, who served as the Chief Minister of UP four times—her Bahujan Samaj Party won only one seat in the last assembly election. Meanwhile, the rise of Chandrashekhar Azad has also weakened his hold on the Jatav vote. With elections just around the corner, why doesn't Mayawati appear as active as Akhilesh and Yogi Adityanath? What is the reason for the BSP's continuous decline?
